clauses.reason: EO6608 amends EO3761 to prescribe recurring post-April 1, 1934 issuance interest, transitional prior-issuance rates, payment when paid with a three-year accrual cap, and independent Governor rulemaking authority. The accrual cap limits each deposit order and is not a whole-order sunset or proof of payment. June 30, 1934 ends one transitional rate period but subsequent interest continues. Held complete EO7234 mirror text section 7 expressly revokes EO6608; sections 3?5 also preserve/replace historical cohort rates and payment conditions. This supports a formal revocation candidate dated November 25, 1935, not proof of first cessation of every scope or extinction/payment of accrued claims. EO3761, enabling statute and intervening regulations are not held here. The dossier fails to locate the held revocation provision mechanically; no act-override adoption is made.
